description: Environment-integrity manifest for Task 3 (door-opening). Verifies the live scene/controller/geometry/hinge configuration against what Phase 7A-7C measured and locked -- this is NOT a data-collection authorization spec (unlike task1_canonical_config.json / task1_collection_spec.json). No demonstration dataset has been collected for this task.

controller.use_oriented_ik_note: Unlike Task 1 (false throughout): Phase 7A/7B measured every arc waypoint meeting both the 8mm position and 7deg orientation tolerance simultaneously -- see reports/phase7a-workspace-map.md and reports/phase7c-door-motion.md.
controller.arm_gains_note: kp raised from Task 1's ARM_KP_4B=400 to clear an ~11mm steady-state settle droop at the PREGRASP_HANDLE posture; ARM_KP_4B itself is never modified. See reports/phase7c-door-motion.md attempt 1.

geometry.derivation: tasks.g1_pick_place.door_open.select_door_geometry, a margin-scored re-search of tasks.g1_pick_place.workspace_map.search_largest_arc's admissible arcs -- NOT the single largest arc Phase 7A reported (see reports/phase7a-workspace-map.md's recommendation).

measured_margins.rest_clearance_note: Computed against the 7 wrist-chain link bodies only. A known, small, operationally-inert exception (door_panel vs left_finger, up to -9.6mm, idle-arm-only, never encountered under active control) is documented in logs/phase7b_selected_door_geometry.json and reports/phase7d-door-tests.md.

hinge.handle_radius_note: == gripper_scene.CUBE_HALF, reused so the handle grip reproduces Task 1's verified squeeze-overtravel mechanics exactly.

success_thresholds.door_open_fraction_note: LIBERO-style: open means hinge_qpos >= 0.75 * authorized swing (33.75deg of 45deg), not the full swing.

current_measured_result.note: Door reaches/exceeds its target open angle; bilateral grip force touches exactly 0.0N at one instant during the pull, so the strict grip-retention and slip criteria fail -- disclosed, not hidden. See reports/phase7c-door-motion.md.
